points.point: Where did the TikTok draft go (not in Blotato)
points.sentence: A TikTok post published as a draft does not appear in Blotato at all -- not in the AI Agent and not in the Remix screen.

points.point: Where to find it instead (TikTok app)
points.sentence: It lands in the TikTok app's notifications (often labeled "System Notifications"), shown as "Draft Video from Blotato."

verdict.reason: The entry states TikTok drafts never appear in Blotato (AI Agent or Remix) and land in TikTok app notifications, answering where the draft went.
